groups.desc: Extends how long the screen stays on before it turns off while on AC power.

groups.desc: Clears the network neighbor (ARP) cache so device lookups start fresh.

groups.title: Tune drives
groups.desc: Defragments and optimizes every local drive for faster file access.

groups.title: Slim Component Store

groups.title: Turn Off dynamic tick (steadier frame pacing)
groups.desc: Disables the dynamic timer tick so timing stays even when idle, smoothing frame pacing. Reboot recommended.

groups.title: Adopt platform tick source
groups.desc: Uses the hardware platform tick instead of the synthetic clock for steadier timing. Reboot recommended.

groups.title: Avoid Forcing HPET as System Clock
groups.desc: Stops Windows forcing the HPET as the system clock, which can add micro-stutter. Reboot recommended.

groups.title: Turn Off CPU Core Parking
groups.desc: Keeps every CPU core awake at all times instead of letting Windows park idle cores.
groups.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor CPMINCORES 100 && powercfg /setdcvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor CPMINCORES 100 && powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor CPMAXCORES 100 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current
groups.revert: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor CPMINCORES 5 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current

groups.title: Lock CPU at 100% minimum state
groups.desc: Forces the minimum processor state to 100 percent so the CPU never downclocks.
groups.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PROCTHROTTLEMIN 100 && powercfg /setdcvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PROCTHROTTLEMIN 100 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current
groups.revert: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PROCTHROTTLEMIN 5 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current

groups.title: CPU Energy Preference: Max Performance (EPP 0%)
groups.desc: Sets the CPU energy preference to favor speed over power savings.
groups.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PERFEPP 0 && powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PERFINCPOL 2 && powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PERFDECPOL 1 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current
groups.revert: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PERFEPP 50 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current

groups.title: Aggressive Processor Boost Mode
groups.desc: Allows the CPU to boost to its highest clock whenever there is demand.
groups.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PERFBOOSTMODE 2 && powercfg /setdcvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PERFBOOSTMODE 2 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current
groups.revert: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor PERFBOOSTMODE 0 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current

groups.title: Adjust kernel worker threads
groups.desc: Increases the kernel worker threads so background system work finishes faster. Reboot recommended.
groups.command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Executive" /v AdditionalCriticalWorkerThreads /t REG_DWORD /d 32 /f && reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Executive" /v AdditionalDelayedWorkerThreads /t REG_DWORD /d 32 /f
groups.revert: reg delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Executive" /v AdditionalCriticalWorkerThreads /f && reg delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Executive" /v AdditionalDelayedWorkerThreads /f

groups.title: Increase GPU timeout (stop TDR crashes)
groups.desc: Waits longer before Windows resets a hung GPU, preventing TDR crash flickers. Reboot recommended.

groups.title: Increase GPU DDI timeout
groups.desc: Extends the display-driver interface timeout so heavy GPU loads do not trigger a reset. Reboot recommended.

groups.title: DirectX GPU Priority (Foreground App)
groups.desc: Prioritizes the foreground app in DirectX scheduling and enables newer swap effects.

groups.title: NTFS Memory Usage Level: High
groups.desc: Lets NTFS use more system memory for its cache. Reboot recommended.

groups.title: Turn Off memory compression
groups.desc: Turns off memory compression so more raw RAM stays free for apps and games.
groups.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Disable-MMAgent -mc"

groups.title: Turn Off 8.3 short file names
groups.desc: Stops creating legacy 8.3 short filenames, which speeds up directory listings.

groups.title: Turn Off delete notification overhead
groups.desc: Lets files delete instantly without the recycle-notification pass, speeding bulk deletes.

groups.title: Ensure SSD TRIM Is Enabled
groups.desc: Makes sure SSD TRIM is enabled so solid-state drives keep writing at full speed.
groups.command: fsutil behavior set DisableDeleteNotify 0

groups.title: Don't spin down drives on AC
groups.desc: Keeps hard disks powered on while on AC power so they never wake up late.
groups.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_disk DISKIDLE 0 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current
groups.revert: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_disk DISKIDLE 1200 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current

groups.title: Turn Off PCIe link power management (ASPM)
groups.desc: Disables PCIe link power saving so graphics cards and add-in cards never stall. Reboot recommended.
groups.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_pciexpress ASPM 0 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current
groups.revert: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_pciexpress ASPM 2 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current

groups.title: Low-Latency TCP Stack Parameters
groups.desc: Applies tuned TCP window and timestamp options for lower latency.

groups.title: Increase dynamic port range
groups.desc: Raises the number of ephemeral ports Windows can use for outgoing connections.

groups.title: Turn On TCP Fast Open / offload friendly flags
groups.desc: Allows TCP connections to start in the first packet, cutting connection setup time.

groups.title: Favor game packets with DSCP 46
groups.desc: Marks game network packets with the highest QoS priority so routers treat them first.

groups.title: Build a QoS policy for game executables
groups.desc: Creates a network QoS policy that gives game traffic priority over other apps.
groups.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\QoS\PRIMExGames" /v "Application Name" /t REG_SZ /d "*.exe" /f && reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\QoS\PRIMExGames" /v "Version" /t REG_SZ /d "1.0" /f

groups.title: Turn Off USB Selective Suspend
groups.desc: Stops Windows from cutting power to USB devices so controllers and dongles stay connected.
groups.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current 2a737441-1930-4402-8d77-b2bebba308a3 48e6b7a6-50f5-4782-a5d4-53bb8f07e226 0 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current

groups.title: Don't turn off the display while gaming
groups.desc: Keeps the screen on permanently so the display never turns off on its own.
groups.command: powercfg /change monitor-timeout-ac 0 && powercfg /change monitor-timeout-dc 0

groups.title: Turn Off away mode interference
groups.desc: Disables Windows away mode so background tasks get full CPU access instead of being masked.
groups.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current 238c9fa8-0aad-41ed-83f4-97be242c8f20 25dfa149-5dd1-4736-b5ab-e8a37b5b8187 0 && powercfg /setactive scheme_current

groups.title: Turn Off Windows Error Reporting prompts
groups.desc: Stops Windows asking to report problems when apps crash.

groups.title: Retain the DWM shader cache
groups.desc: Keeps the desktop compositor shader cache so UI effects do not recompile. Reboot recommended.

groups.title: Configure Error Reporting service to manual
groups.desc: Sets the Windows Error Reporting service to start manually instead of automatically.

groups.title: Spooler: Print on Demand
groups.desc: Sets the Print Spooler service to start manually so it only runs when printing.

groups.title: Turn Off Windows Maps broker
groups.desc: Disables the Windows Maps service so it stops running in the background.

groups.title: Turn Off search web results and highlights
groups.desc: Stops the search box mixing in web results and search highlights.

groups.title: Turn Off Nagle's Algorithm
groups.desc: Sends small packets immediately instead of batching them, lowering online-game latency.
groups.command:
$root = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces'
Get-ChildItem $root | ForEach-Object { New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TcpAckFrequency -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TCPNoDelay -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TcpDelAckTicks -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
}
Write-Host 'Nagle disabled on all network interfaces.'

groups.title: Turn Off Network Throttling
groups.desc: Removes the built-in network throttling that caps Windows throughput.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name NetworkThrottlingIndex -Value (-1) -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name SystemResponsiveness -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
groups.revert:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name NetworkThrottlingIndex -Value 10 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name SystemResponsiveness -Value 20 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Tune TCP Stack
groups.desc: Applies a tuned TCP configuration for faster, more responsive connections.
groups.command:
netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal
netsh int tcp set global rss=enabled
netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled
netsh int tcp set global timestamps=disabled
netsh int tcp set global nonsackrttresiliency=disabled
netsh int tcp set supplemental template=internet congestionprovider=ctcp
groups.revert:
netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal
netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=default
netsh int tcp set global timestamps=default

groups.title: Reclaim Reserved Bandwidth
groups.desc: Frees the bandwidth Windows reserves for system services so your apps can use it.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Psched'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name NonBestEffortLimit -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Favor IPv4 over IPv6
groups.desc: Prefers IPv4 so connections do not stall waiting on an IPv6 lookup.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters' -Name DisabledComponents -Value 32 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Halt NIC Power Saving
groups.desc: Stops the network adapter entering low-power sleep, which causes lag spikes.
groups.command:
Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e972-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match '^\d{4}$' } | ForEach-Object { New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name PnPCapabilities -Value 24 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null }
Write-Host 'Power management disabled for all network adapters.'
groups.revert: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e972-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match '^\d{4}$' } | ForEach-Object { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name PnPCapabilities -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

groups.title: Increase Port / Socket Limits
groups.desc: Raises per-connection port and socket limits for heavy network load.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name MaxUserPort -Value 65534 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name TcpTimedWaitDelay -Value 30 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name DefaultTTL -Value 64 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Favor Games (MMCSS)
groups.desc: Registers game processes with the Multimedia Class Scheduler so they get priority CPU time.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'GPU Priority' -Value 8 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Priority' -Value 6 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Scheduling Category' -Value 'High' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'SFIO Priority' -Value 'High' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Affinity' -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Background Only' -Value 'False' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

groups.desc: Adds an Open Terminal Here option to folder right-click menus.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\Directory\Background\shell\PRIMExTerminal'
New-Item -Path "$k\command" -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name '(Default)' -Value 'Open PowerShell here (Admin)'
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Icon' -Value 'powershell.exe'
Set-ItemProperty -Path "$k\command" -Name '(Default)' -Value 'powershell.exe -NoExit -Command "Set-Location -Path ''%V''"'

groups.title: Insert "Copy as Path"
groups.desc: Adds a Copy as Path option to file and folder right-click menus.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\*\shell\PRIMExCopyPath'
New-Item -Path "$k\command" -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name '(Default)' -Value 'Copy as path'
Set-ItemProperty -Path "$k\command" -Name '(Default)' -Value 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Set-Clipboard -Value ''%1''"'

groups.title: Build God Mode Folder
groups.desc: Creates the God Mode folder that lists every Windows setting in one place.

groups.title: Strip "- Shortcut" Suffix
groups.desc: Cleans the shortcut suffix text from new shortcut names.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'link' -Value ([byte[]](0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00)) -PropertyType Binary -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Bypass the Lock Screen
groups.desc: Goes straight to the sign-in screen instead of the lock screen.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization' -Name NoLockScreen -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Detailed Startup Messages
groups.desc: Shows exactly which step Windows is doing during sign-in.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name VerboseStatus -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: In-Depth Blue Screens
groups.desc: Makes stop screens show full driver and bugcheck detail.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl' -Name DisplayParameters -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Force NumLock at Startup
groups.desc: Turns NumLock on automatically at sign-in.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name InitialKeyboardIndicators -Value '2' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'Registry::HKEY_USERS\.DEFAULT\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name InitialKeyboardIndicators -Value '2' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Mute Notification Center
groups.desc: Disables Action Center notifications and banners.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PushNotifications'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name ToastEnabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Name DisableNotificationCenter -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
groups.revert:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PushNotifications' -Name ToastEnabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Name DisableNotificationCenter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

groups.title: Turn Off Snap Assist Flyout
groups.desc: Stops the snap layouts flyout appearing when you hover the maximize button.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name EnableSnapAssistFlyout -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Deny Lock Screen Camera
groups.desc: Blocks camera access from the lock screen.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization' -Name NoLockScreenCamera -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Strip Preinstalled Bloatware
groups.desc: Removes preinstalled junk apps such as OEM and Store promotions.
groups.command:
$targets = @('Microsoft.3DBuilder','Microsoft.BingFinance','Microsoft.BingNews','Microsoft.BingSports', 'Microsoft.BingWeather','Microsoft.GetHelp','Microsoft.Getstarted','Microsoft.Messaging', 'Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer','Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub','Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection', 'Microsoft.MixedReality.Portal','Microsoft.NetworkSpeedTest','Microsoft.Office.OneNote','Microsoft.OneConnect', 'Microsoft.People','Microsoft.Print3D','Microsoft.SkypeApp','Microsoft.Todos','Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub', 'Microsoft.WindowsMaps','Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder','Microsoft.YourPhone','Microsoft.ZuneMusic', 'Microsoft.ZuneVideo','Clipchamp.Clipchamp','MicrosoftTeams','MSTeams','Microsoft.549981C3F5F10', 'Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes','Microsoft.WindowsAlarms','Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop')
$removed = 0
foreach ($t in $targets) { $pkgs = Get-AppxPackage -Name $t -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue foreach ($p in $pkgs) { Remove-AppxPackage -Package $p.PackageFullName -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Write-Host (' removed ' + $p.Name); $removed++ } Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq $t } | ForEach-Object { Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -PackageName $_.PackageName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null } }
Write-Host ('Debloat complete — ' + $removed + ' package(s) removed.')

groups.title: Remove OneDrive
groups.desc: Uninstalls OneDrive and its Explorer integration.

groups.title: Strip Xbox Apps
groups.desc: Removes preinstalled Xbox apps and their background hooks.
groups.command: @('Microsoft.XboxApp','Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay','Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay', 'Microsoft.XboxSpeechToTextOverlay','Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider','Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI') | ForEach-Object { Get-AppxPackage -Name $_ -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Write-Host (' removed ' + $_) }

groups.title: Restore Default Apps
groups.desc: Reinstalls the default Windows apps this pack removes.
groups.command:
Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers | ForEach-Object { Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register ($_.InstallLocation + '\AppXManifest.xml') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Write-Host 'Default apps re-registered.'

groups.title: Purge Temp & Prefetch
groups.desc: Deletes temporary files and prefetch data to free space.
groups.command:
$before = (Get-PSDrive C).Free
@("$env:TEMP\*", "$env:SystemRoot\Temp\*", "$env:SystemRoot\Prefetch\*") | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_ -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
$freed = [math]::Round(((Get-PSDrive C).Free - $before) / 1MB, 1)
Write-Host ('Temp cleaned — ' + $freed + ' MB freed.')

groups.title: Purge Recycle Bin
groups.desc: Permanently deletes everything currently sitting in the Recycle Bin.
groups.command: Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Recycle Bin emptied.'

groups.title: Thorough Disk Cleanup
groups.desc: Runs a full disk cleanup of update leftovers, thumbnails and other junk.
groups.command:
Start-Process cleanmgr.exe -ArgumentList '/verylowdisk' -Wait -WindowStyle Hidden -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Process dism.exe -ArgumentList '/Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup /Quiet /NoRestart' -Wait -WindowStyle Hidden -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host 'Disk cleanup finished.'

groups.title: Flush Event Logs
groups.desc: Clears Windows event logs, freeing disk space and old entries.
groups.command:
Get-WinEvent -ListLog * -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.RecordCount -gt 0 } | ForEach-Object { try { [System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession]::GlobalSession.ClearLog($_.LogName) } catch {} }
Write-Host 'Event logs cleared.'

groups.title: Fix System Files (SFC)
groups.desc: Scans and repairs protected Windows system files.
groups.command: sfc /scannow

groups.title: Fix Windows Image (DISM)
groups.desc: Repairs the Windows component store image when SFC is not enough.
groups.command: dism.exe /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth

groups.title: Auto Time & Timezone
groups.desc: Sets the time and timezone to update automatically.
groups.command:
Set-Service -Name tzautoupdate -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service -Name tzautoupdate -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service -Name W32Time -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service -Name W32Time -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
w32tm /resync /force

groups.title: Adopt UTC for Hardware Clock
groups.desc: Stores the hardware clock in UTC so dual-boot systems keep correct time.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation' -Name RealTimeIsUniversal -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Turn On Long File Paths
groups.desc: Allows paths longer than 260 characters system-wide.
groups.command:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem' -Name LongPathsEnabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Turn Off NTFS Last-Access Stamps
groups.desc: Stops NTFS writing a timestamp on every file read, cutting disk writes.
groups.command: fsutil behavior set disablelastaccess 1

groups.title: Suspend Windows Updates
groups.desc: Pauses Windows Update so nothing installs until you resume.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name FlightSettingsMaxPauseDays -Value 3650 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
$k2 = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate'
New-Item -Path $k2 -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k2 -Name DeferFeatureUpdates -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k2 -Name DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays -Value 365 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host 'Updates deferred. Security updates still install.'
groups.revert:
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name DeferFeatureUpdates -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

groups.title: Prevent Auto-Restart After Updates
groups.desc: Stops Windows restarting your PC on its own after updates.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name AUPowerManagement -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Don't Sleep on AC
groups.desc: Keeps the PC awake while plugged in.
groups.command:
powercfg /change standby-timeout-ac 0
powercfg /change monitor-timeout-ac 0
powercfg /change disk-timeout-ac 0
powercfg /change hibernate-timeout-ac 0

groups.title: Turn Off USB Selective Suspend (PowerShell)
groups.desc: Keeps USB devices powered so controllers and dongles never disconnect.
groups.command:
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 2a737441-1930-4402-8d77-b2bebba308a3 48e6b7a6-50f5-4782-a5d4-53bb8f07e226 0
powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\USB' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem $_.PSPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = Join-Path $_.PSPath 'Device Parameters' if (Test-Path $p) { New-ItemProperty -Path $p -Name EnhancedPowerManagementEnabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null } } }
Write-Host 'USB selective suspend disabled.'

groups.title: Reduce UAC Prompt Level
groups.desc: Lowers User Account Control prompts; fewer popups but less protection.
groups.command:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin -Value 5 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name PromptOnSecureDesktop -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
groups.revert:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin -Value 5 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name PromptOnSecureDesktop -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

groups.title: Turn Off Hyper-V Platform
groups.desc: Disables the Hyper-V virtualization platform, which can reduce gaming latency.
groups.command:
Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Microsoft-Hyper-V-All -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype off
Write-Host 'Hyper-V disabled — reboot required.'
